$comment: Shared invocation-record header. workerStatus is OPTIONAL and, when present, uses the model-owned vocabulary ONLY (WORK_COMPLETE/BLOCKED/FAILED/NO_CHANGE) — PATCH_READY and controller dispositions are invalid here. Absence of workerStatus means "no valid worker status was received" (e.g. START/timeout/provider error/crash/orphan before any valid handoff). The controller must NEVER synthesize a worker status merely because execution failed, timed out, crashed, or produced an invalid handoff. Sprint 01 owns the full lifecycle ledger.
title: LCIM V2 shared invocation record header
